subject: Request: coverage-extension bridge memo for SOC 2 Type II gap - Silverline Health
messages:
From: Jessica Park <jessica.park@silverlinehealth.com>
To: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@silverlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Interim coverage memo request for procurement (SOC 2 Type II)

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we work through procurement for our pilot, our security team needs an interim assurance that covers the period between your most recent SOC 2 Type II report end date (2026-05-31) and our contract start (2026-09-01).

Can Redwood provide a short bridge/coverage memo (one page or short letter) that: 1) confirms there have been no material control changes in-scope since 2026-05-31, or 2) describes any changes and compensating controls; and 3) lists the artifacts available for review (e.g., change control log, KMS access matrix, incident log snapshot).

We need anything you can provide by Friday 2026-07-24 to meet our procurement timeline. For context, the request is specifically for the security reviewers at Silverline Health.

Attached is a one-page template our vendor team prefers (Silverline_SOC2_Summary_Request.pdf). Happy to jump on a quick call if that's easier.

Appreciate it,

Jessica Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Silverline Health

---
Attachment: Silverline_SOC2_Summary_Request.pdf (1 page template)
From: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Park <jessica.park@silverlinehealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim coverage memo request for procurement (SOC 2 Type II)

Hi Jessica,

Thanks for the clear ask and the template — that's helpful. Looping in Neha (Security & Compliance) and Aditya (Engineering lead for infra) so we can pull the right artifacts.

A few clarifying questions so we prepare an appropriate bridge memo:
- Do your reviewers need a statement that there were no control exceptions, or is a description of any exceptions + remediation plan acceptable?
- Is the preferred audience technical (security engineers) or procurement/legal? We can tailor level of detail accordingly.
- For artifacts, are screenshots/extracts acceptable, or do you need full logs? We can supply redacted excerpts.

Neha/Aditya — can you confirm whether anything material changed in-scope since 2026-05-31 (deployments, control ownership changes, KMS rotation events, or significant policy updates)? If we're clean, we'll prepare a short bridge memo signed by our SOC owner and include the listed artifact excerpts. If there were changes, outline what changed and any compensating controls.

We will aim to provide a draft by Thu 2026-07-23 so Jessica can review before your Friday deadline.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

---
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Jessica Park <jessica.park@silverlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim coverage memo request for procurement (SOC 2 Type II)

Connor / Aditya,

Quick status: no material control exceptions were recorded in our tracking system since 2026-05-31. A couple of routine infra changes occurred (minor config updates to autoscaler and one scheduled KMS key rotation for our staging cluster) — these were pre-approved per change control and have documented approvals and rollback steps.

I've attached a short CSV excerpt with the relevant change-control rows (change_control_log_excerpt.csv) and will prepare a concise narrative for the bridge memo that calls out the rotation and the compensating approval/segregation-of-duties controls.

Aditya: can you confirm whether the KMS rotation affected any production encryption key material or was limited to staging? Also confirm the date and whether we have the KMS rotation audit event exported.

Jessica: if redacted excerpts are OK, we'll include them as attachments to the memo. If you need full logs, let us know and we'll route through an NDA/secure transfer.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security and Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: change_control_log_excerpt.csv (3 rows)
From: Jessica Park <jessica.park@silverlinehealth.com>
To: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@silverlinehealth.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim coverage memo request for procurement (SOC 2 Type II)

Connor/Neha,

Thank you — that level of detail is perfect. Redacted excerpts are fine for now; the reviewers want a short signed memo and the two excerpted artifacts you mentioned (change-control rows and the KMS rotation audit event). If you can attach a one-page signed bridge memo and the two excerpts by end of day Friday (2026-07-24), procurement will be able to proceed with the purchasing request.

For turnaround: once we receive the memo, our security team will do a quick review (same day) and follow up only if there are outstanding items. No NDA required for redacted excerpts.

I'll plan to accept a DocuSign or PDF for the signed memo. If you want, you can use our preferred template but it's not required.

Appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
Jessica Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Silverline Health

---
Next steps: Redwood to provide draft bridge memo + two artifact excerpts by 2026-07-24 EOD. Attachment requested: redwood_bridge_memo_draft.docx (will be accepted as PDF/DocuSign).
